finding: Budget form: @google/genai surfaced 1 thought part(s) (thoughtsTokenCount numeric=true (135)); the AI SDK surfaced 1 reasoning part(s) (reasoningTokens numeric=true (138)). Level form: genai 1 thought part(s), AI SDK 1 reasoning part(s). On the wire, budget form: genai sent generationConfig.thinkingConfig={"thinkingBudget":512,"includeThoughts":true} and the AI SDK sent {"thinkingBudget":512,"includeThoughts":true} (expected {thinkingBudget:512, includeThoughts:true}: genai=true, ai-sdk=true), so budget-form wire parity is true. Level form: genai sent generationConfig.thinkingConfig={"thinkingLevel":"low","includeThoughts":true} and the AI SDK sent {"includeThoughts":true,"thinkingLevel":"low"} (expected {thinkingLevel:'low', includeThoughts:true}: genai=true, ai-sdk=true), so level-form wire parity is true. Both forms also produced thinking content with a numeric thinking-token count on both adapters, so the accounting geminiUsageToUsageStats reads is demonstrated.
